subject: Re: AWS GovCloud metering & entitlement — next steps for SaaS contract
messages:
From: Lauren Price <lauren.price@acme.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS GovCloud metering & entitlement — initial details

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Acme liked the latency guarantees and the private deployment option. Procurement asked me to put together the immediate questions we have on the AWS GovCloud listing and SaaS entitlement mapping so we can finalize internal approvals. High-level asks: 

- Do you support Seller-Supported Metering for GovCloud (aws-us-gov-east/west) or only AWS SaaS partner metering?
- Can you confirm which SKU granularity you expect from our side (per-seat, per-project, monthly-seat-hour)?
- What is your recommended entitlement identifier mapping for customers that are already using ACME internal product IDs?

I'm attaching our governance checklist and procurement intake. If you can reply with a short checklist and, ideally, a reference metering template we can pass to legal, that would be really helpful. If it helps, happy to put procurement and our cloud security engineer on a call — they prefer Wed/Thu this week.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Price
Head of Cloud Procurement | Acme Robotics
[Attachment: acme-governance-questions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@acme.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS GovCloud metering & entitlement — initial details

Hi Lauren — great to hear the demo landed well. Looping in Karthik (marketplace integrations) and Marissa (billing/onboarding) to answer the detailed questions. Quick answers while they chime in: 

- Redwood supports both SaaS Partner Metering and Seller-Supported Metering in GovCloud; our recommended path for regulated customers is Seller-Supported Metering with a GovCloud seller account to minimize cross-region data egress.
- SKU granularity: our most common pattern for enterprise ACME-like setups is monthly-seat-hour (SKU per product-seat) to balance accuracy and minimal per-call overhead. We can map to per-project SKUs if you require project-level reconciliation.
- Entitlement IDs: we typically expose a stable entitlement_id that maps to the customer's internal product id. See Karthik's note below for the mapping CSV schema (we can accept a column of your ACME IDs and produce the mapping).

We've attached a metering template and a short CSV schema we use. Karthik — can you confirm the expected pub/sub payload for GovCloud (topic names + sample JSON) and whether any extra signing is required? Marissa — after we align on SKU granularity, can you outline the procurement handoff and DocuSign steps?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rdw-aws-govcloud-metering-mapping.csv (csv)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Price <lauren.price@acme.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS GovCloud metering & entitlement — initial details

Thanks — adding the technical details below. I'm including a short sample payload and notes specific to GovCloud.

1) Metering path: Seller-Supported Metering (recommended)
- We will provision a GovCloud seller account that publishes usage events to AWS Marketplace metering service in GovCloud. No cross-region S3 writes by default.

2) Expected usage event (sample):
{
  "productCode": "rdw-acme-saas",
  "dimension": "seat-hour",
  "quantity": 120,
  "timestamp": "2026-11-26T15:05:00Z",
  "customerIdentifier": "entitlement_abc123"
}

- For GovCloud we'll sign events with the GovCloud marketplace role; no extra payload envelope is required beyond standard AWS Marketplace Metering API.

3) Entitlement mapping:
- If ACME provides a CSV with column ACME_PRODUCT_ID, we will return a mapping with ENTITLEMENT_ID and SKUs. See attached mapping CSV stub.

4) Operational notes:
- We recommend a 24-hour batching window for seat-hour granularity to avoid bursts and to minimize API call counts.
- For audit, Redwood exposes an export of raw events and a summarized metering ledger via the Console (we can provide S3 export into your GovCloud bucket if required).

Attachment: aws-metering-template-v2.docx (this includes sample IAM role snippets and the pub/sub topic naming pattern)

If this looks good I'll prepare a short runbook (1–2 pages) for the procurement and security teams.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Platform Engineer, Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: aws-metering-template-v2.docx (docx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@acme.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS GovCloud metering & entitlement — initial details

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear asks. From a procurement and billing handoff perspective here are the immediate next steps we recommend: 

1) Redwood will provision a Seller account in GovCloud and share the IAM role details with ACME. (Owners: Marissa/Ben)
2) ACME to provide CSV with ACME_PRODUCT_ID column and preferred SKU granularity by 12 Dec. We'll validate mapping within 3 business days.
3) DocuSign: we'll send a SaaS Fulfillment Addendum (covers metering and settlement cadence) once the mapping is agreed. Expect a single-sign flow for procurement + finance.
4) Internal compliance: if you'd like raw event exports into an ACME-owned GovCloud S3 bucket, we'll add that to the SOW as a deliverable (requires bucket policy + cross-account role).

Open items: pricing cadence (monthly invoice vs. Marketplace settlement). Ben, can you propose the default settlement cadence and any upfront credit options for ACME's pilot?

Lauren — is Thursday 3 Dec 10:00 AM PT a good time for a 30-min technical + procurement sync? If so we'll send a calendar invite and the runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-govcloud-metering.pdf (pdf)]

Lauren
